initialPrompt: You are a bot able to read cards. I need you to read the attached Hubworld: Aidalon card and provide me the type of card. You'll find it on the type line at the bottom of the card and it should be either Agent, Moment, Obstacle, Seeker or Source. A Seeker is the only type without a shard cost in the top left corner and the only one with two stat boxes on the right side of the card. Only return the type.
cardDetectionPrompt: You are a precise object detector. The attached image is a Hubworld: Aidalon card reveal or spoiler image that may contain one or more individual trading cards, arranged side by side or in a grid. Detect every complete, individual trading card in the image. Return ONLY a JSON array with no markdown fences and no surrounding text. Each element must be an object with exactly two fields: "label", a short string naming the card (use the card's printed name if you can read it, otherwise "card"), and "box", an array of four integers [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] giving the card's bounding box normalized to a 0-1000 scale relative to the image's height (y) and width (x). Include only actual cards; ignore the background, logos, watermarks, decorative borders, shadows, and any card that is heavily cut off at the image edge. If the image contains a single card filling most of the frame, return that one card with a box covering it. If no cards are visible, return an empty array [].

properties.description: The card name printed in the title bar at the top of the card. Ignore any bullet (•) printed in front of the name.
The smaller name printed directly below the card name.
Printed on the type line at the bottom of the card, either to the right of the type or directly below it. For a Seeker this is a value like Paragon.
The number in the stat box on the right side of the card that sits next to the small rectangular card symbol. It is the left one of the two stat boxes.
The number in the stat box on the right side of the card that sits next to the angular shard (triangle/gem) symbol. It is the right one of the two stat boxes.

The rules text in the main text box. Surround bold text with the | character, replace inline icons with their token ([shard], [card], [action], [reaction], [breach], [barrier], [presence]) and separate multiple ability paragraphs with \r. Leave out flavor text.

The small pip icons printed on the bottom edge of the card, on the frame around the type line. Count every pip and return one value per pip based on its color: purple = Remnants, orange = Omniworks, green = OldAidalon, blue = Collective. Separate them with commas, so three blue pips become Collective,Collective,Collective. If there are no pips, return an empty string.
Determined by the color of the card frame and of its pips: purple = The Remnants, orange = Omniworks, green = Old Aidalon, blue = The Collective. ALWAYS return exactly one of those four values.
The artist name printed in the bottom corner of the card, in the corner opposite the collector number.

Located in one of the bottom corners of the card in the collector line, written as [set code] - [card number]/[total cards], for example PRC - 006/164. Only return the [card number] part, without leading zeros.
